title: Security Event Log Maximum Size Insufficient (< 1GB)
description: The Windows Security log size must be configured to at least 1,048,576 KB (1 GB) to prevent log wrapping and retain crucial audit telemetry.
impact: High event volume during an incident will overwrite older evidence before analysts can collect it.
remediation_guidance: Increase Security log capacity: Limit-EventLog -LogName Security -MaximumSize 1GB

compliance_mappings.title: Ensure 'Application: Control Event Log behavior when the log file reaches its maximum size' is configured
